sloka: प्रविवेश स्व निलयम् मिथिलाम् मिथिलेश्वरः ।राजा अपि अयोध्या अधिपतिः सह पुत्रैः महात्मभिः ॥१-७४-७॥
transliteration: praviveśa sva nilayam mithilām mithileśvaraḥ ।rājā api ayodhyā adhipatiḥ saha putraiḥ mahātmabhiḥ ॥1-74-7॥

translations.english: The Lord of Mithila bestowed a lot of wealth on his daughters and with the consent of the king (Dasaratha) reentered his residence in Mithila.
